day_shape: 96 items: US-Iran deal said imminent with Rubio in Delhi calling it 'work in progress', Iran FM spokesman Bagheri's lengthy press conference on Hormuz and Pakistani-mediated messaging, IDF soldier killed by Hezbollah drone in south Lebanon, NPT Review Conference ended without consensus.

threads.label: US-Iran deal framework taking shape
threads.summary: Times of Israel cited a US official saying an Iran deal would be signed in coming days with wording still being finalised, while Rubio in New Delhi said talks remained 'a work in progress'. Reports said Iran agreed in principle to give up highly enriched uranium; Netanyahu said Trump agreed any final deal must dismantle enrichment sites, and Israeli sources told the Jerusalem Post the emerging text omits missiles and proxies.

threads.label: Bagheri press conference: Hormuz, mediation, EU
threads.summary: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Bagheri said messages were being exchanged with the US via a Pakistani mediator and that the focus of negotiations was ending the war, not nuclear matters. He said Iran and Oman were drafting a Hormuz safe-passage protocol and was not collecting tolls, criticised the EU for not sanctioning the US and Israel, and dismissed Rubio's remarks on Iranian missile spending.

threads.label: Hezbollah clashes and Rubio condemnation
threads.summary: The IDF announced Sgt. Nehoray Leizer, 19, was killed by a Hezbollah drone in southern Lebanon, and Avichay Adraee issued evacuation warnings for ten south Lebanon villages. Rubio issued a State Department statement condemning Hezbollah chief Naim Qassem's call to dissolve the Lebanese government, while the IDF drew up Lebanon contingency plans.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz reopening and mine-clearing
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported the British navy is preparing to clear mines in the Strait of Hormuz pending an Iran deal, while Iranian state-linked media said a US deal would restore ship traffic within 30 days and release frozen funds. Jerusalem Post commentary warned that Hormuz control would be a 'lifeline' for Tehran.

threads.label: NPT Review Conference ends without consensus
threads.summary: The State Department issued a statement from spokesperson Tommy Pigott saying the United States regretted that NPT states parties failed to reach consensus on a final document at the 2026 Review Conference. The statement said the inability of some parties to take Iran's threat seriously would be addressed by the United States.

threads.label: Khamenei whereabouts and regime messaging
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel cited US officials telling CBS that Supreme Leader Khamenei is in a secret location communicating via a courier network. Khamenei's office posted messages on confronting the 'American way of life' and honouring martyrs' families, while Defa Press said a death sentence was carried out against an alleged December 2025 'armed coup' leader.

threads.label: Iran-linked influence and procurement reports
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported a suspected Iranian intelligence operation used Telegram to recruit people in Britain for anti-Israel protests and antisemitic activity, and that an Iran-linked cyber group targeted entities in the US, Israel and UAE. Separate reporting said the IRGC used a UAE-based company to procure Chinese satellite equipment for its drone programme.
